intro: North Korea is a one-party dictatorship ruled by the Kim family.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Kim Jong Un leads the Workers' Party of Korea, the state and the army. Elections offer one approved candidate. Huge statues and portraits honour the Kims.

chapters.title: Military first
text: North Korea has one of the largest armies in the world and spends heavily on missiles.

keyTerms.meaning: Rule by one person or group without real elections.
